g.text: U1-U2: upstream context; D1, D2, D3: minimum downstream steps from RPL11
All direct RPL11 edges: 1 incoming, 3 outgoing
Upstream U1-U2 nodes provide context and are not counted in KDA neighborhoods
Deeper mitochondrial hits retained at 1/3 or more
Colored outer boundary; segments show multiple memberships
Thick black border: recurrent mitochondrial query hit
Node size and x/3 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D3 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
